units.source_text: 我们是日本学生工读实行会的成员，又是从事大日本松叶食奖励会工作的。

en.t: We are members of the Japan Student Work-Study Implementation Association, and we also work for the Greater Japan Pine-Needle Food Promotion Association.

units.source_text: 现在我代表前面的讲演者只谈十分钟的话，不急着走的人，重视身体健康的人，请听我来说。

en.t: Now, speaking on behalf of the previous lecturer, I will talk for only ten minutes, so those who are not in a hurry to leave and those who value their health, please listen to what I have to say.
